name: rn-update
description: React Native OTA hot update SDK for Android, iOS, Expo and HarmonyOS, with differential downloads and crash rollback.

scripts.prepack: bun submodule && bun lint && bun run build:types
scripts.test:release-guards: node --test scripts/package-candidate.test.js scripts/package-source-closure.test.js scripts/check-binary-strings.test.js scripts/verify-android-so.test.js && python -B scripts/test-harmony-har.py --har harmony/pakta.har -v && python -B scripts/test-binary-strings-har.py --har harmony/pakta.har -v
scripts.lint: biome check src app.plugin.js && tsc --noEmit && node scripts/check-harmony-types.js && bun run check:contract
scripts.test: bun run test:contract && bun run test:rn077-generator && bun test src/__tests__
scripts.test:harmony-e2e: cd Example/e2etest && RNU_E2E_SKIP_PREPARE=true npm run test:e2e:harmony
scripts.e2e:harmony: npm run build:harmony-e2e && npm run test:harmony-e2e
scripts.build:ios-debug: cd Example/e2etest && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bunx detox build --configuration ios.sim.debug
scripts.build:ios-release: cd Example/e2etest && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bunx detox build --configuration ios.sim.release
scripts.test:ios-debug: cd Example/e2etest && node scripts/run-detox.js ios test --configuration ios.sim.debug
scripts.test:ios-release: cd Example/e2etest && node scripts/run-detox.js ios test --configuration ios.sim.release
scripts.build:android-debug: cd Example/e2etest && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bunx detox build --configuration android.emu.debug
scripts.build:android-release: cd Example/e2etest && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bunx detox build --configuration android.emu.release
scripts.test:android-release: cd Example/e2etest && E2E_PLATFORM=android bunx detox test --configuration android.emu.release --headless --record-logs all
scripts.test:android-debug: cd Example/e2etest && E2E_PLATFORM=android bunx detox test --configuration android.emu.debug --headless --record-logs all
scripts.smoke:android-debug: cd Example/e2etest && bunx detox test --configuration android.emu.debug --config e2e/smoke/jest.config.js
scripts.tests:emulator:prepare: cd .github/workflows/scripts/functions && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.tests:packager:jet-ci: cd Example/e2etest && cross-env TMPDIR=$HOME/.metro REACT_DEBUGGER="echo nope" node_modules/.bin/react-native start --no-interactive
scripts.tests:ios:pod:install: cd Example/e2etest && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bunx pod-install

author: Yoghourt Technology(BeiJing) Company Limited
